description: Proposed Roads (LGATE-130) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. The proposed roads dataset, which complies with WALIS defined specifications, has been built in response to increasing demands from both public sector and industry organisations for a road centreline dataset. The roads dataset has been compiled by merging the roads layers of the metropolitan street directory, 1:25,000, 1:50,000 and 1:100,000 digital datasets. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are csroads, proposed, road, subscription, topo. It offers 11 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
